text: The meeting reviewed progress on finishing the end report.
The PM will redesign something now.
Key problems discussed include disagreement on remote control speech recognition and budget overruns, with cost figures and budget accounting identified as misaligned (items 2, 3, 8, 9).
Decisions were made on the hardware and branding: use a single touch-screen, black and red color scheme for the remote, a cheap white/neutral standard cover, and a design with ten buttons.
